contract.title: Wave A: ranking-features-v1.ts extractRankingFeaturesV1
contract.invariant: extractRankingFeaturesV1 output order and missing indicators exactly match the sealed R1.1 feature-contract index (search_features_v1); canonical round-trip. Forbidden feature identities never appear. No central runtime file changes in Wave A.
production_callers: packages/mcp/src/core/search-constants.ts (A4 anchor: SEARCH_RRF_K=60 at :1, SEARCH_RERANK_RRF_K=10 at :21, SEARCH_RERANK_WEIGHT=1.0 at :22 — frozen baseline-mode compatibility constants per invariant 7)
interface_changes: packages/mcp/src/core/ranking-features-v1.ts (new file; extractRankingFeaturesV1 producing the fixed ordered search_features_v1 numeric vector per §5.2)
security_boundaries: Forbidden features: repository name, task ID, absolute path, user identity, candidate identity hash, owner-family identity hash, provider hash (§5.2, invariant 15); no feature may change deterministic eligibility (invariant 1/3)
overlap_with: D2/D5/D7 (Waves D): require A4 (exact prerequisite table)
R1.1: feature contract index is the sealed authority the extractor must match
contract.instructions: Create packages/mcp/src/core/ranking-features-v1.ts (new file) exporting extractRankingFeaturesV1 per §5.2: fixed ordered numeric vector with missing indicators, explicit one-hot and interaction features (test-path x test-intent, test-path x implementation-intent, docs-path x docs-route, generated x explicit-generated-or-path-intent), explicit stage ranks (rawDenseRank?, rawLexicalRank?, rawFallbackLexicalRank?, coreFusionRank?, mcpUnionRank?, postEligibilityRank?, rerankerAdmissionRank?), and the bounded confidence mapping from the existing 3-level intent confidence and hard booleans (never fabricated probabilities). §7.6 A4 RED row: test 'feature_order_and_missing_indicators_match_sealed_contract'; expected failure: extractor emits reordered or unsealed features; minimal passing: output order and missing indicators exactly match R1.1. Forbidden features per §5.2/invariant 15. Constants SEARCH_RRF_K=60 (search-constants.ts:1), SEARCH_RERANK_RRF_K=10 (:21), SEARCH_RERANK_WEIGHT=1.0 (:22) are frozen (invariant 7). Focused command is plan-specified (§7.5 A4 row) and targets a test file absent at round_base: unverifiable-at-base. Affected command pnpm --filter @zokizuan/satori-mcp test is repo-verified and must pass.
